summary: Sam Altman describes prompting ChatGPT from his phone to use chat history and build a full-stack coordination site for a friend trip.

practices.reason: Anecdotal personal use case of ChatGPT performing a multi-step agentic task, not a stated benchmark or released capability change.
practices.quote: use all my chat history to figure out ideas for a long weekend trip with 8 friends, plan the best three options, make a full-stack site where the 9 of us can coordinate on what we would want to do in
